card.name: Time units ending a duration phrase
card.fires_on: The time-unit word or digit that completes a span of time, such as hour, minutes, day or shift, often after a number like one, two, thirty or 4 (as in 48). The pole is weaker on some other nouns like storms.

modes.label: Hours and minutes after a number
modes.description: A unit of time right after a number in a duration, such as within one hour or at least thirty minutes.
modes.example: wait at least thirty<< minutes>> following the last sound of thunder or lightning

modes.label: Digit inside a number of hours
modes.description: The last digit of a number like 48 just before the word hours.

modes.label: Day or shift as a period
modes.description: A period noun like day or shift in a general, non-medical phrase.
modes.example: service as many as 40 customers in a single<< shift>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward crowd and onlooker words and away from repeat and monthly words, which is a weak and mixed effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word or digit of a length of time, like 'within one hour' or '48 hours'.
